name: Scroll hint
summary: Mouse outline with a dot sliding down, fading chevrons and a scroll label; for prompting viewers to scroll.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 280 px tall at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: scroll dot colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
